SQL Master; PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQ: SQL Master lets you query your PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite and DuckDB databases and your CSV and Excel files in a single Windows app: schema browser, SQL editor and visual query builder.
Windows için · Hesabım sayfanızdan kişiy: For Windows · Personal download from your My account page
Veritabanı işleri, olması gerektiği gibi: Database work, the way it should be
Bağlantılarınızı düzenleyin, sorgularını: Organize your connections, write your queries and see your data at a glance.
PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL,: PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite and DuckDB. With DuckDB, query CSV, Parquet, JSON and Excel files directly and combine them in a single query.
Renkli kartlar, sürükle-bırak klasörler,: Color-coded cards, drag-and-drop folders, search and duplication; all your connections on one screen.
Sunucudan veritabanına, şemadan tablo, g: From server to database, from schema to tables, views, functions, procedures, triggers, indexes and columns; objects load on demand.
Tabloya çift tıklayın, ilk kayıtlar ızga: Double-click a table and the first records appear in the grid; hiding columns, sorting and filters are instantly reflected in the SQL that fetches the data.
Sekmeler, Ctrl+Enter ile çalıştırma, oto: Tabs, run with Ctrl+Enter, autocomplete, multiple result sets, cancel and query history; definitions with syntax highlighting.
Tabloları tuvale sürükleyin, kolondan ko: Drag tables onto the canvas, draw JOINs from column to column, choose columns and conditions; the SQL is built live.
Büyük tablolarda sonuçlar parça parça ge: On large tables, results arrive in chunks; the interface stays responsive even with millions of rows.
Sonuçları CSV, TSV ya da JSON olarak kay: Save results as CSV, TSV or JSON; hundreds of thousands of rows go straight to the file without being loaded into memory.
Salt okunur mod varsayılan açık, değişik: Read-only mode on by default, confirmation before changes; passwords stored in Windows DPAPI, TLS and SSH tunnel.
Bağlantılarınız, klasörleriniz ve ayarla: Your connections, folders and settings sync across your devices with end-to-end encryption; the server cannot read the content.
Koyu, açık ya da sistem teması; Türkçe v: Dark, light or system theme; Turkish and English interface.
Diğer Mastertool uygulamalarındaki hesab: Sign in with the account you use for the other Mastertool apps; downloads, devices and support are at mastertool.download.
